snippet.title: Mosaic of the Strange - OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
Mosaic of the Strange is out now on Steam! 

Tile by tile, solve sprawling Minesweeper/Picross logic puzzles, with each opening a real-world paranormal file that brings you closer to the truth behind a chilling murder.

Blending logic and narrative, Mosaic of the Strange introduces dialogue-driven storytelling to the series for the first time. Players join Special Agents Cullen and Brady as they investigate a gruesome murder steeped in eerie, paranormal undertones. Could the truth lie beyond the limits of science?
With five difficulty settings (changeable at any time), more than 67,000 tiles to solve, and over 140 paranormal case files to uncover, Mosaic of the Strange offers a huge amount of content and replayability. Optional Advanced Deduction tactics give seasoned puzzlers an extra challenge, while newcomers can relax and enjoy the story at their own pace.

Try before you buy with the FREE demo on Steam!
🧩Demo: https://bit.ly/MotS_Demo
🧩Full Game: https://bit.ly/MotS_Steam
